jobs.title: Software Engineer - Fullstack
jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
 **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
**Primary Responsibilities**
* Design, code, test, and deploy end\-to\-end full\-stack applications in a high\-performing, scalable enterprise environment
* Develop responsive and interactive user interfaces using modern front\-end technologies including HTML5, JavaScript, TypeScript, ReactJS, jQuery, and Node.js
* Build scalable back\-end microservices and web services using Java, Spring Boot, and enterprise application servers (Red Hat JBoss EAP, Tomcat)
* Design, optimize, and maintain relational database queries and schemas utilizing SQL Server, Oracle, or MySQL
* Implement automated test suites using Mockito, JUnit, and Selenium to maintain continuous integration and software quality standards
* Build, maintain, and enhance DevOps CI/CD pipelines and containerized deployments using Jenkins, Azure, Docker, and GitHub
* Actively participate in Agile ceremonies and engineering practices (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe), collaborating with cross\-functional product and engineering teams to deliver iterative software solutions
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so


**Required Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of full\-stack software development experience in high\-performing, scalable application environments
* 2\+ years of experience with front\-end technologies including HTML5, JavaScript, TypeScript, ReactJS, and Node.js
* 2\+ years of experience building microservices and web services with Spring Boot and application servers such as Tomcat or Red Hat JBoss EAP
* 2\+ years of experience working with relational databases (SQL Server, Oracle, or MySQL)
* 1\+ years of experience with automated testing tools and frameworks (JUnit, Mockito, or Selenium)
* 1\+ years of experience with DevOps tools and practices, including CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Git/GitHub, Docker, and Microsoft Azure
* Experience working within an Agile development methodology (Scrum, Kanban, or SAFe)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
* Hands\-on experience deploying, managing, and optimizing microservices in Microsoft Azure cloud environments
* Experience with jQuery and modern front\-end state management libraries
* Demonstrated solid technical troubleshooting, problem\-solving, and code optimization skills in high\-concurrency environments


*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Scale.jobs** 




 Scale.jobs is a career\-tech platform providing end\-to\-end job search assistance to job seekers across the globe, offering Career Coaching (Resume Writing, LinkedIn Optimization, Interview Prep), Human\-led Job Finding and Applying, and AI\-Tailored Resumes and Cover Letters, combining Human \+ Technology to get job seekers hired faster and smarter.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer (Next.js \+ tRPC) to work closely with the founding team in building and scaling a modern, high\-performance web platform. You'll play a key role in shaping both the product and engineering decisions, collaborating across product, engineering, and marketing to deliver a seamless user experience. This is a role for someone who is comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment, taking ownership, and contributing across the stack, from frontend UX to backend APIs and integrations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Build and maintain scalable web applications using Next.js (App Router) and React 18
* Develop end\-to\-end type\-safe APIs using tRPC and backend services with Hono
* Design and manage database schemas and queries using PostgreSQL and Prisma
* Collaborate directly with co\-founders to define product requirements, architecture, and roadmap
* Work closely with the marketing team to implement SEO strategies and optimize web performance
* Integrate third\-party services like Clerk (authentication) and Stripe (payments)
* Implement responsive and accessible UI using Tailwind CSS, Shadcn, Radix UI, and modern component patterns
* Manage server state and data fetching using TanStack React Query
* Contribute to analytics, logging, and monitoring using tools like PostHog and Axiom
* Participate in code reviews, architectural discussions, and performance optimizations
* Work within a monorepo setup (pnpm \+ Turborepo) for efficient development and scaling



  





**Must\-Have Qualifications** 



* Proficiency in TypeScript
* Hands\-on experience with Next.js and React
* Experience building APIs using tRPC or similar frameworks
* Solid understanding of backend development (Node.js\-based frameworks like Hono or Express)
* Experience with PostgreSQL and ORMs like Prisma
* Strong knowledge of REST/HTTP concepts, API design, and data fetching strategies
* React Query (TanStack Query) for server state management
* Experience with modern styling approaches like Tailwind CSS
* Familiarity with Git and collaborative workflows
* Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to take ownership of features from concept to production



  





**Nice\-to\-Have Skills** 



* Experience with monorepo setups using Turborepo and pnpm
* Familiarity with authentication systems like Clerk
* Experience with Stripe or payment integrations
* Experience with AI integrations (e.g., OpenAI, Vercel AI SDK)
* Exposure to Docker and cloud services like AWS S3
* Experience working on SEO optimization and performance improvements
* Prior experience working closely with founders or startup teams



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* Owning and shipping features end\-to\-end with minimal hand\-holding
* Writing clean, scalable, and well\-documented code that the team can build on
* Proactively identifying performance bottlenecks and resolving them before they become problems
* Contributing meaningfully to architectural and product decisions alongside the founding team



  





**What's in It for You** 



* Work directly with the founding team, fast learning and real ownership from Day 1
* Shape the product and engineering culture at an early\-stage, fast\-growing startup
* Work on a modern, cutting\-edge tech stack across the full product lifecycle

**We're Hiring: Conversational AI Engineer** 




 Looking for an engineer who loves building autonomous AI agents, multi\-step agentic workflows, and robust conversational systems. If you excel at turning business logic into production\-grade AI solutions, we want to hear from you!
 



**Role Details** 



* **Role:** 
 Conversational AI Engineer
* **Experience:** 
 2\+ Years
* **Location: Pune/Chennai/Kochi (Hybrid Mode)**
* **Notice Period:** 
 Immediate Joiners preferred



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design scalable bot/agent architectures and multi\-step agentic workflows.
* Create prompts, personas, guardrails, and deterministic hybrid GenAI flows.
* Integrate CRM, ERP, and CCaaS systems using REST APIs, MCP, and GraphQL.
* Transform and validate LLM outputs using JS/TS, Python, or Java.



**Tech Stack \& Requirements** 



* **Conversational AI Platforms:** 
 Cognigy.AI, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Amazon Connect, Amazon Lex, Google CCAI, Kore.ai, Microsoft Bot Framework, or Parloa.
* **Core Languages:** 
 JavaScript/TypeScript (Node.js) required; Python or Java preferred.
* **APIs \& Protocols:** 
 REST, GraphQL, gRPC, MCP.
* **LLM \& GenAI Concepts:** 
 System Prompts, Guardrails, Context Windows, Embeddings, Temperature, RAG (Pinecone/Weaviate/pgvector).
* **DevOps \& Tools:** 
 Git, Jira, Docker, CI/CD, AWS/Azure/GCP.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer (Python + React)
jobs.description:
Monefy is a business and technology services company based in Brașov, Romania. We run
back-office operations for healthcare practices in the US, and we build the software those
practices use for their day-to-day work. We're the operator as well as the vendor, so we
end up using most of what we build.

We look for people who ask a lot of questions, finish what they take on, and want to keep
getting better at the job.

## About the product

You'll be working on our healthcare platform: an EHR (electronic health record) and medical
billing system used by clinics in the US. It covers patient records, scheduling, intake, a
patient portal, insurance claims and payment posting.

The data is medical and the numbers end up on real invoices, so we're careful about
correctness and about who gets to see what.

## The role

You'll own features from start to finish: backend, frontend, database migrations and tests.
Usually you'll pick up something a clinic has asked for and stay with it until it's live,
and we'll expect you to be able to explain the choices you made along the way.

You'll report to the CTO and work with him closely, which means plenty of mentoring and
plenty of scrutiny on your work.

### What you'll do

- Build features across the stack: Django/DRF APIs, React + TypeScript interfaces, schema
  changes and tests.
- Write a short design plan before you start coding, and talk it through with us.
- Check your own work before anyone else sees it: run it, try to break it, fix what you find.
- Walk a reviewer through your code, line by line if they ask.
- Find your way around a large codebase you didn't write, and leave it a bit tidier than
  you found it.
- Learn the domain: how clinics schedule, what an insurance claim is, how a payment gets
  posted.

## What we're looking for

- At least a year of professional Python web development. If you don't have that on paper
  but you have your own complex projects you can talk us through in detail, apply anyway.
- Python with Django (Flask or FastAPI counts) and REST API design.
- React with TypeScript, and the SPA basics: state, routing, async, talking to an API.
- SQL and an ORM. You can read a schema, write a query with a few joins in it, and work out
  what a migration will do to data that's already there.
- Comfortable with Git and with a Unix-based OS.
- You write tests, and you also open the application and check that it behaves the way it
  should.
- You can read code you didn't write, say what it does and spot where it's likely to break.
- You can explain every line of code you submit, including anything you generated.
- Clear written and spoken English. You'll be writing short design documents most weeks and
  discussing them daily.
- Based in Romania and available Monday–Friday, 12:00–21:00 EEST.

## Nice to have

- Django REST Framework, Celery, OpenAPI-generated clients.
- Testing tooling: pytest, vitest/jest, Playwright.
- AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, CloudFront, ElastiCache).
- You've worked on a team with real code review, where your pull requests came back with
  changes requested.
- Any exposure to healthcare, insurance or billing systems.
- Patience for an unglamorous domain. Healthcare admin is full of small rules and edge
  cases, and it rewards people who find that sort of thing interesting.

## Who you are

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Strong attention to detail
- Logical thinker with strong analytical skills
- Displays a high level of initiative and resourcefulness
- Seeks out opportunities for creative expression and exploration
- Prefers an agile work environment over traditional structures

## What we offer

- **€2,000–3,000 gross / month**, depending on what you can demonstrate.
- **Real ownership**: whole features across frontend, backend, migrations and tests.
- **A learning budget** for courses, books and conferences.
- Private medical insurance, which kicks in once you're past your first three months.
- Team-building activities, and a company that means it about work-life balance.
- An early-stage product, so what you build reaches clinics quick

jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
   

  

 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high\-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co\-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
   

  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025\. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.


**About The Role**
 As an Intermediate Backend Engineer, you will take backend features and improvements from clarifying the problem through shipping them and following up in production. You will work within a product area, partnering with Product Management, Frontend, Infrastructure, and Security to deliver predictably and contribute to the quality, security, performance, and maintainability of shared backend code and services. You will be trusted to work with minimal guidance, to know when to seek help, and to communicate clearly in a remote, asynchronous environment — with other tenured engineers alongside you to review your work, think through hard problems with you, and help you grow.
   

  

**Why you’ll love this role**
* Ownership: You'll take features from requirements through delivery and follow\-up; your code will run on a platform used by millions of users.
* Learning and Growth : You’ll work alongside your engineering team, who treat code review and design review as a learning loop rather than a gate — one of the fastest ways to grow your engineering judgment.
* Innovative Culture: You’ll use AI as a genuine part of daily engineering work, developing the judgment to know when to trust it and when not to.
* Autonomy: You’ll thrive in our remote\-first, asynchronous organization, where clear written communication and self\-direction are the pillars of success.
* User\-Centric Collaboration: You’ll partner closely with PMs and designers to shape requirements, so you understand why you’re building something, not just what.


**What You’ll Do**
* Own and Ship Features: Design, implement, test, and ship backend features and improvements with minimal guidance, working in Ruby/Rails, Go, or any other modern languages.
* Build for Production: Write maintainable, secure, observable, and performant code. Design and maintain APIs, background jobs, integrations, and bounded service functionality, and work with data models, migrations, indexes, and query behavior.
* Test and Review: Add and improve automated coverage — unit, integration, contract, and end\-to\-end where appropriate — and review others’ code for correctness, maintainability, security, performance, and operational risk.
* Operate What You Build: Investigate build, test, deployment, and runtime failures at the feature boundary, identify technical debt and propose practical improvements, and take part in on\-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.
* Leverage AI: Use AI productively in daily work, validate what it produces, and understand where its limitations matter.


**What You’ll Bring**
* Backend Fundamentals: Professional experience building and shipping production backend applications, with strong programming, API, database, testing, debugging, and performance fundamentals.
* Adaptability: Experience with Ruby/Rails, Go, or any other modern backend language. We value the ability to learn and adapt over mastery of a single language.
* Feature Ownership: The ability to take a feature from clarification through delivery and follow\-up, working independently while seeking input at the right time.
* Practical Judgment: Sound instincts about security, reliability, performance, maintainability, and operational risk, plus an understanding of modular backend boundaries and the consequences of coupling.
* Clear Communication: Strong written communication and effective collaboration in a remote, asynchronous environment.
* AI Fluency: Practical experience with AI coding tools, including the ability to review and correct what they generate.


**Helpful Experience**
* Production Go services, APIs, concurrency, profiling, or gRPC.
* Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, CI/CD, or cloud deployment.
* Rust, particularly for systems, security, performance, or platform work.
* PostgreSQL, schema evolution, caching, queues, messaging, or event\-driven workflows.
* Observability using metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerts.
* Contributing to a modular monolith, bounded context, shared component, or independently operated service.


**How GitLab Supports Full\-Time Employees**
* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well\-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation \& Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave

jobs.title: AI Engineer, Product
jobs.description:
**AI at Brex**

AI Engineering at Brex is redefining how businesses run their finances by building intelligent, autonomous systems directly into the Brex platform. Our teams develop AI agents that don’t just surface insights—they take action, optimizing spend, managing workflows, and making real-time decisions on behalf of our customers. By deeply integrating proprietary financial data with product and platform infrastructure, we’re turning complex financial operations into simple, automated experiences and setting a new standard for how modern finance works.

**What you’ll do**

You'll be a product engineer building Brex's Audit Agent — an agentic system that reviews customer spend at scale and replaces the manual work traditionally done by BPO teams. The agent itself reasons; the surrounding product harness is what makes that reasoning useful, trustworthy, and operable for real customers.

That product harness is where you'll live. You'll design and ship the workflows, surfaces, and data flows that turn the agent's output into something a reviewer can trust and act on — from the reviewer experience itself, to the contracts with Brex's financial system of record, to the feedback loops that make the agent better over time. You'll move fluidly between backend and frontend as the work demands, picking the right altitude for the problem rather than defending a layer.

This role sits between deep agent design and the customer-facing UI, and it leans toward whichever side the next user problem lives on. You'll partner closely with the engineers driving each — translating ambiguous product requirements into shipped features, pushing back when the design isn't right, and treating the seam between agent reasoning and human workflow as a first-class product surface.

The majority of your work will be backend: system design, data modeling, API shape. A meaningful minority will be on the UI itself, where you'll build alongside our frontend engineers when that's where the next user problem lives.

**Where you’ll work**

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We require three coordinated days in the office per week — Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

**Responsibilities**

- Build and ship customer-facing features in production — from sketch to rollout to iteration based on real customer feedback.
- Define the data contracts between the agent and the rest of Brex's financial system of record, and evolve them as the product gets sharper.
- Stand up feedback and evaluation loops that let us quickly gather product signals and close them with product fixes — better signals, better surfaces, better workflows.
- Run experiments on customer-facing behavior (UI flows, prompt-driven product changes, new review modes) and make calls based on what the data says.
- Talk to customers and reviewers directly, bring what you learn back into the product, and prioritize what to build next on the team.

**Requirements**

- Strong track record of shipping customer-facing features end-to-end across both backend and frontend — you don't bounce work over a wall, and you've built enough of each to have real opinions.
- Product mindset: you reason about users, workflows, and outcomes first, and treat the system as the means to an end. Comfort with ambiguity and willingness to talk to customers directly.
- Strong bias towards action — you've operated in environments where the next thing to build wasn't handed to you in a ticket, and you've shipped things that didn't exist before.
- Comfort working across team boundaries and pushing back on decisions outside your direct ownership when the seam isn't right — agent design, UX, data model, all fair game.
- Strong backend foundation — system design, data modeling, API shape — and the disposition to ship the UI yourself when that's what the user problem needs, rather than handing it off

**Bonus points**

- Early-stage startup experience, or time on a small team where you owned a product surface end-to-end.
- Experience building products on top of LLMs or agentic systems — particularly the surrounding harness (evaluation, tracing, feedback loops, human-in-the-loop workflows).
- Background in fintech, compliance, audit, fraud, or other domains where review workflows and traceability matter.
- Experience operating where the underlying system is non-deterministic and the product has to compensate for that.
- Track record of being the engineer teams pull in when a project is stuck across backend, frontend, and a third system that nobody fully owns.

**Compensation**

The expected salary range for this role is $171,000 - $240,000 USD.  However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

- Own Brex's MCP Apps for OpenAI, Claude, Slack, and other embedders, including roadmap decisions across core and long-tail partners.
- Define the technical, UX, and reliability standards for how Brex surfaces and operates within external AI assistant ecosystems.
- Design and maintain secure, auditable integration patterns, including permissions, read/write access, and acting on behalf of users across third-party environments.
- Build and operate production-grade integrations that remain resilient amid evolving platforms, unpredictable clients, and shifting constraints.
- Partner cross-functionally with Security, Platform, Sales, Enablement, and internal agent teams to ensure integrations are safe, valuable, and well-supported.
- Serve as the center of excellence for reusable AI capabilities across Brex, defining and evangelizing standards, patterns, and shared components that power AI functionality both within the Brex platform and across external ecosystem integrations.

**Requirements**

- Experience building and owning production software, including systems that integrate with or depend on third-party platforms.
- Demonstrated technical ownership for user-facing products with real external customers.
- Deep experience with identity, authentication, and secure data access across system boundaries, including OAuth and role-based access control (RBAC) for permissions.
- Proven ability to ship and operate reliable integrations with external APIs and clients outside your control.
- Strong product judgment, written communication, and end-to-end ownership, including accountability for quality and launch readiness.

**Bonus points**

- Experience publishing and maintaining apps or integrations in third-party marketplaces (iOS, Slack, Shopify, GitHub, Chrome, etc.).
- Prior work on administrative or platform-side tooling for ecosystems.
- Familiarity with conversational or agentic interfaces in production environments.
- Experience building evaluations to measure and improve the quality, reliability, and safety of AI-powered features.

**Compensation**

The expected salary range for this role is $171,000 - $240,000 USD.  However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

At ​Isarsoft ​we develop video analytics software ​to make transportation and cities more efficient, inclusive and secure. ​We stand for data protection and responsible processing of sensitive data.   • Strong communication skills and a problem-solving mindset with a focus on helping users.

  • Fluency in both English and German (min. C1 level required).

  • Ability to work up to 20 hours/week during the semester (flexible during semester breaks).


Additional assets

  • Familiarity with Docker or Linux environments.

  • Basic understanding of Computer Vision or AI applications.

  • Prior experience in a startup or fast-paced tech environment

  • Modern development workflow proficiency, including the confident and reliable use of AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor).

  • Strong foundation in version control systems (Git) and hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines


Benefits

  • A high-impact work environment with flat hierarchies and short decision-making processes

Sounds good? We are just getting started. Let's build a great company together.

We are committed to a transparent and fair hiring process. We aim for concluding the interview process in no longer than 2 weeks.

The following three stages are typical for any position at Isarsoft.

  • Video Interview with HR

## About the job
### About Sunset
At its core, Sunset was founded to help founders. We started by supporting startups through shutting down, but we have since expanded into unlocking a new revenue stream for all types of businesses.
In 2025, we had a unique insight: the data every company generates each day through collaboration, communication, and building is some of the most valuable training data in the world. Public and synthetic data can only get frontier models so far, so the next generation of model progress depends on real, proprietary data grounded in how actual businesses operate. We are a primary source of it, partnering directly with the frontier AI labs building what comes next.
### Why Join Sunset Now
  * We have scaled from $0 to a multi-eight-figure run rate in a matter of months
  * We have raised from top-tier investors, including Floodgate, Afore, Ludlow, and Hustle Fund
  * We are small enough that you will carry outsized responsibility and grow as quickly as the company does
  * You will partner with and build for some of the fastest and most important companies in the world
  * You will help build a massive, category-defining business from the ground floor


### The Role
We're hiring a backend engineer to make the pipeline that de-identifies sensitive enterprise data correct, replayable, operable, and safe to change.
This is not a conventional data-platform role where a successful job is enough. A pipeline can finish while silently dropping records, duplicating output, applying stale policy, losing lineage, or producing evidence that cannot establish whether a dataset is safe to release. You will own the backend systems and contracts that make those failure modes visible, preventable, and recoverable.
You will work across asynchronous orchestration, batch workers, queues, object storage, databases, many file formats, model-backed stages, deterministic verification, and human review. The role is backend-focused, but the outcome is a product and delivery promise: the team must know what ran, what changed, what remains uncertain, and what can safely happen next.
### What You'll Own
  * Design and ship backend systems for multi-stage, high-volume data processing
  * Define authoritative, versioned contracts for manifests, artifacts, lineage, and state transitions
  * Make retries, checkpoints, partial failures, replay, backfills, migrations, and rollbacks safe and understandable
  * Build independent reconciliation and verification instead of treating job success as proof of correct output
  * Turn escaped and recurring failures into fixtures, regression coverage, release gates, and durable recovery paths
  * Expose trustworthy run state and safe controls to the products people use to investigate and release data
  * Diagnose production behavior across code, queues, stores, artifacts, data formats, and deployed versions
  * Improve correctness, throughput, and operating leverage without weakening privacy, security, or release confidence
  * Use AI deeply in development and in bounded verification systems, with explicit evaluation and independent checks
  * Partner with machine learning, applied science, full-stack product, platform, security, and data engineering teammates


### What Success Looks Like
  * A high-risk pipeline boundary has an explicit contract, independent reconciliation, replayable coverage, and safe recovery
  * Missing, duplicated, stale, or incompatible work is detected before it becomes a customer delivery
  * Material pipeline state and release decisions are backed by queryable provenance and audit evidence
  * Recurring reruns, manual interventions, and diagnosis or recovery time decline
  * Adjacent engineers can add stages and checks through supported patterns instead of one-off scripts and implicit storage conventions
  * Pipeline changes can be rolled out, backfilled, quarantined, or reversed without delivery heroics


### You Might Thrive Here If
  * You have at least three years of professional software engineering experience, including personal ownership of production backend systems
  * You are strong in asynchronous or distributed systems and can reason precisely about queues, concurrency, state, storage, idempotency, partial failure, and recovery
  * You have worked on systems where output could be materially wrong even when every service looked healthy
  * You define invariants and use reconciliation, control totals, diffs, replay, goldens, shadow paths, or independent sources to verify correctness
  * You can design versioned data and artifact contracts and migrate them safely in a live system
  * You debug from evidence across system

A groundbreaking leader in consumer privacy, data ethics, and foundational identity, LiveRamp is setting the new standard for building a connected customer view with unmatched clarity and context while protecting precious brand and consumer trust. LiveRamp offers complete flexibility to collaborate wherever data lives to support the widest range of data collaboration use cases—within organizations, between brands, and across its premier global network of top\-quality partners.**

 Design, build, and maintain ML and data workflows that use BigQuery, GCS, and related cloud services to support internal products and downstream consumers.

jobs.description:
We are on the hunt for
 **AI/ML Engineer** 
 who harbors a deep\-seated passion for artificial intelligence. Do you love solving problems with a unique blend of creative flair and meticulous attention to detail? You'll be a critical contributor to the creation of cutting\-edge AI models, honing their performance to perfection and masterfully translating complex theoretical constructs into robust, production\-caliber innovations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Help craft, refine, troubleshoot, and deploy sophisticated predictive models, deep learning algorithms, and machine learning frameworks.
* Unravel the intricate workings of ML algorithms, including their structures and features, identify root causes of any pesky bugs and design intelligent solutions.
* Delve into the depths of data to distill root issues, prepare detailed reports, and detect recurring problem patterns through insightful analysis.
* Design and develop large language model (LLM) use cases, ensuring they are equipped with appropriate guardrails and leverage advanced LLM Operations techniques to guarantee a high\-quality output upon productionization.
* Train and retrain systems as needed, incorporating adaptability and foresight into the continuous improvement process.
* Conduct thorough literature reviews to stay at the forefront of the latest developments in the specified research areas.
* Analyze and interpret research findings and use the learnings to design and build AI models and algorithms.
* Engage proactively in regular team meetings to share progress, address challenges, and brainstorm potential improvements.

## About the job
### **About idler**
idler is a frontier data research lab. We build the evals and environments that the world's leading frontier labs use to measure and train their models.
After raising a $9m seed round led by Paradigm, we spent the last year developing coding evals for top coding models you know and love. At the same time, we've expanded into other domains besides coding: RSI & Auto-Research, Law, Enterprise Business, Cybersecurity, and others. Now, we are facing more lab demand for our data than we can serve, and are rapidly scaling the team to grow the business.
Our approach to creating training data scales using technology, and all of our data products are built on a unified self-reinforcing platform that learns through experience.
You would be joining a close-knit team that has reached product market fit, and your work would directly help to multiply our revenue.
You can see some of our work here: <https://idler.ai/collections>
### **About the Role**
Special Projects Operators are responsible for the relationships and the operations that connect our network of experts to our data production. As an SPO, you will recruit, onboard, and manage our experts, and you will build the systems and tooling to automate your recruitment and management processes. This role is half project management, half engineering.
If you want to start a company one day, this is a good place to learn how.
**In this role, you will:**
  * Recruit experts into our network — find the communities they belong to, build relationships within those communities, and bring the best people on board.
  * Design our expert hiring process — work with our research team to build the screening rubric for each new domain, run it, and automate as much of it as you can.
  * Run the network day to day — onboard experts, schedule them onto projects, fill gaps when someone drops out, check the quality of their work, run the payment cycle, and answer the support inbox.
  * Build the tooling the network runs on — replace the manual steps in applications, qualification, scheduling, scoring, payments, and reporting, and improve how our team and our experts communicate.
  * Keep the paperwork organized — run payroll tasks, file compliance documents, and provision and remove accounts.


**What we value**
  * Scrappiness with people — you find the person who knows the person, and you are comfortable approaching a community you are not yet part of.
  * Grit, coupled with good judgement — you're comfortable operating in ambiguous, high-intensity environments. You're independent and resourceful, but you know when you should ask for help before acting.
  * Meticulous attention to detail — you would rather find and fix the problems in your work than let someone else discover them for you.


**Requirements**
  * One to four years in an operationally intense environment, or an exceptional record as a new graduate.
  * Ability (and enthusiasm) to build your own tools with AI assistance. A professional engineering background is not required, but you must be able to read the documentation and get something working unaided.
  * Extraordinary literacy, as evidenced by written and verbal communication. You will write to experts, to partners, and to us.
  * A high tolerance for ambiguity, intensity, and sustained effort when the problem demands it.


**You might excel if you…**
  * Have earned a place in a community you started outside of, and can explain how you did it.
  * Throw events, or host often, and know how to make people want to show up.
  * Come from a high-pressure, metrics-driven field like consulting or banking, where you had to be presentable and hit numbers at the same time.


### **Details**
  * In-person in San Francisco
  * Competitive salary + meaningful equity
  * Free meals in office
  * Healthcare, 401(k), 15 days of PTO per year
  * Relocation assistance
  * Small, ambitious team


This is an in-person role in San Francisco. We're a tight-knit founding team and we play to win. Join us if you like to win too.
Apply Now

# Naukri Resdex, LinkedIn and Recruitment agency pricing and trends in India
![Author image](https://secure.gravatar.com/avatar/ed5306bbe8c173a1354023e139e5537a9d5faa0c155a27d30124255453f11874?s=96&d=monsterid&r=g)
#### Anubhav Gupta
Sep 23, 2025
* * *
[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fcutshort.io%2Fblog%2Fhiring%2Fnaukri-resdex-linkedin-and-recruitment-agency-pricing-and-trends-in-india)[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=%0Ahttps://cutshort.io/blog/hiring/naukri-resdex-linkedin-and-recruitment-agency-pricing-and-trends-in-india%0A&hashtags=)[](https://www.linkedin.com/sharing/share-offsite/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcutshort.io%2Fblog%2Fhiring%2Fnaukri-resdex-linkedin-and-recruitment-agency-pricing-and-trends-in-india)
For companies hiring in India, choosing how they source and find talent is one of the most important decisions. Naukri Resdex, LinkedIn and Recruitment agencies are the most common offerings in the Indian market today.
Let’s dive into the complex but fascinating world of India’s recruitment market – especially how **Resdex** , **LinkedIn recruiters** , and **recruitment agencies** stack up on pricing and long-term trends. Here’s what you need to know…
## The Three Pillars: Resdex, LinkedIn & Recruitment Agencies
India’s recruitment industry stands on three giant pillars:
  * **Naukri Resdex** : The go-to candidate database for in-house recruiters.
  * **LinkedIn Hiring Solutions** : Powered by social mapping and direct hiring tools.
  * **Recruitment Agencies** : Classic search partners working on success fees.


Each has distinct pricing models, advantages, and pain points. But pricing trends are shifting, reflecting India’s red-hot talent war and digital transformation.
## Naukri Resdex Pricing: How Much Are You Paying Today?
Naukri Resdex is a subscription service offered by Naukri.com, giving recruiters database access to millions of resumes. If you’re a corporate recruiter or a startup founder, chances are high that you’ve evaluated or used Resdex at some point.
### Current Pricing Models
  * Subscription based – usually sold in packages (monthly, quarterly, or yearly).
  * Credits or resume download limits – more credits mean higher cost.
  * Additional features (like advanced search, AI recommendations, etc.) come at a premium.


As per several enterprise recruiters and market watchers,
  * Base pricing for Naukri Resdex in 2025 starts around ₹55,000 for three months (entry plan),
  * Mid-range plans can exceed ₹3 lakh annually depending on seat count and features.
  * **Enterprises typically pay anywhere from 50 Lakhs to 3 crores/year.**


### 2025 Naukri Resdex Pricing Trend: The 15% Hike
Here’s where it gets interesting. We did a survey recently and many TA leaders reported a consistent **15% increase in Resdex pricing over the last 12-15 months**.
![Two donut charts compare naukri resdex subscription patterns and pricing trends. The left chart: 60% always subscribe, 18% buy as needed, 22% use sporadically. The right chart: 15% note yearly naukri resdex pricing hikes; 25% see higher annual rises.](https://cutshort.io/blog/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/screenshot-23_09-11_58_39-am-1024x768.jpg)
##### **Check out the complete survey report here**
This aligns with India’s rising demand for premium digital hiring solutions. The good news? If you’re an early customer or have annual contracts, you might still have some leverage – but renewals are getting pricier fast.
What does this mean for you? If Resdex is a must-have in your toolkit, planning your budget for 2025 will need a closer look at ROI and alternative sourcing strategies.
### What This Means For Recruiters
  * **Budget Creep** : Costs rising faster than inflation means scrutinizing every renewal.
  * **Need for Negotiation** : Many companies find discounts or bundled deals, but only by bargaining hard.
  * **Switching Incentives** : High price increases are pushing some firms to explore LinkedIn or even revival of agency models.


In short, Resdex is still the default – but the value equation is shifting. What do you think: Should digital databases get this costly?
## LinkedIn Hiring Solutions: Steady, But Not Static
If Naukri is the database king, LinkedIn offers “active + passive” talent – candidates who might not upload their CVs but stay open to recruiter messages.
### LinkedIn Pricing Models
  * Seat-based subscriptions (e.g., **LinkedIn Recruiter Lite** , **LinkedIn Recruiter Corporate**).
  * Pricing by region and package level, often invoiced annually.
  * Pay-per-click/post options for sponsored jobs.


In India, a **LinkedIn Recruiter Lite** seat runs roughly ₹8,000 to ₹9,200 per month, with full-feature Recruiter licenses exceeding ₹2 lakh/year. Exact pricing reflects team size and special deal

jobs.description:
**Description**
 Selling Partner Identity Verification (SPIV) team ensures that Amazon is a safe and trustworthy place to shop and an amazing place to build a successful business selling products. We support this mission through providing a secure and accurate Identity verification platform. Identity verification is becoming a critical component to protect our customers from bad actors and provide fast and secure registration and account management capabilities. We provide an end to end solution for identity verification and account lifecycle management for various Amazon businesses across globe (North America, Europe, Japan, China and more). Our customers include Mechanical Turk, Selling on Amazon, Amazon Pay, Amazon Flex etc. We continuously strive to scale our systems to serve millions of Amazon customers with high accuracy, least friction, in a highly secure manner to enable a safe and secure shopping experience for customers.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Engineers in the team need a strong understanding of Computer fundamentals and practical experience in working with large scale distributed systems. Experience with web services\-based applications, especially at massive scale, is helpful.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3\+ years of building complex software systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. # Intern – Founder’s Office: Growth Sales & PR
## at [Crea8 ](https://cutshort.io/company/jobs-at-crea8-90-aMH5BDuU)
![Prabhav Agarwal's profile picture](https://cutshort.io/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.cutshort.io%2Fpublic%2Fusers%2F69a549489f4d3b41ccf442ef&w=3840&q=75)
Posted by Prabhav Agarwal
Apply to this job
0 - 1 yrs
₹10000 - ₹15000 / mo
Remote only
Skills
Sales
Sales management
Public Relations
**Location:** Remote | Immediate Joining
**Duration:** 2 months (with potential PPO)
**Stipend:** ₹10,000 – ₹15,000/month + LoR 
  

Important Note: 
Email your resume, work samples, and a brief cover letter to us. Please include your relevant experience and why you believe you would be a good fit for the role.
  

**About Crea8**
"Will this product work for me?" sounds like a simple question. The skincare industry has spent decades making sure it isn’t. Most skincare content online is confusing, biased, or brand-driven. We think that's broken.
  

Crea8 (www.crea8.co.in) is a skincare personalisation engine that helps D2C brands guide every shopper to the right products. It combines skin profiling, ingredient-level formulation analysis, and explainable AI to deliver transparent, personalised recommendations that build trust, improve conversion, and increase customer lifetime value.
  

We're early stage, moving fast, and building something that matters in a space that desperately needs more honesty and simplicity.
  

**Why this role exists**
There's a rule we build this entire company around: no one cares about you. Not journalists. Not bloggers. Not the brands we're trying to sell. They care about what's useful to them and their audience. The email that says "please write about us" gets ignored. The pitch that hands someone a valuable story, a sharp data point, something they care about, gets a reply.
  

That's PR, and it's really just sales wearing a different outfit. Instead of convincing a buyer to buy our product, you're convincing a stranger to spend their credibility on you, because what you're offering is genuinely worth their time.
  

**What you'll actually do**
**Earned Visibility:** Build relationships with journalists, independent bloggers, and creators across skincare, beauty, wellness, and the startup world. Get Crea8 talked about because the story earns it, not because we paid for it.
  

**Distribution:** Take what we're already writing and put it in front of people who aren't on our radar yet, communities, groups, and creators wherever our audience actually spends time.
  

**You're a good fit if**
  * You can write a pitch that gives something before it asks for anything
  * You're fine hearing NO a lot, and reaching out again anyway
  * You think like a salesperson who thinks like a consultant
  * You're okay with ambiguity. You'll work directly with me, not inside a structured corporate program
  * You actually want to learn how early-stage startups build visibility from zero


  

Important Note: 
Email your resume, work samples, and a brief cover letter to us. Please include your relevant experience and why you believe you would be a good fit for the role.

### **About the Role:**
We are seeking an accountable, motivated, and detail-oriented Junior Financial Analyst to join Perpay’s Finance & Accounting Team. This role requires strong quantitative skills along with the ability to distill complex information and communicate it effectively. As a key contributor to this team, you will work closely with our Accounting and Analytics functions to strategize and report on various business initiatives, metrics, and ad hoc projects.
Our greatest strength is our people and we’d love for you to be one of them!

  * Provide support in the financial modeling of our existing operations and key initiatives
  * Own and drive various strategic ad hoc projects and analyses while partnering closely with Analytics, Risk, Marketing, and Operations

  * Own and champion process improvement efforts to streamline financial planning and budget management procedures to drive efficiency and accuracy

  * Strong analytical skills and attention to detail
  * A winning mentality and willingness to go the extra step to get the job done right

jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer Intern – Swarm Systems (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
What we offer

  • Work in an international, agile team building autonomous robotic systems
  • Contribute to software that is tested on real robotic platforms and in the field
  • Gain hands-on experience with state-of-the-art technologies in robotics, autonomy, and multi-agent systems
  • Work closely with experienced robotics and embedded engineers
  • Take ownership of meaningful technical projects while receiving guidance from the team
  • Benefit from a steep learning curve and a collaborative engineering culture


Your mission

Join our robotics team working on autonomous systems that operate as coordinated, distributed agents in real-world environments. 

As a Software Engineering Intern, you will contribute to the development and validation of our multi-UAV system, with a particular focus on software tooling, simulation, and system observability. 

Depending on your background and the project, you may also contribute to areas such as SLAM, navigation, perception, planning, or multi-agent coordination. This is a hands-on internship where you will develop and test software, work with real robotic systems, and see how your work performs beyond simulation. 

  • Develop data-driven dashboards and tools to monitor, analyze, and visualize system performance
  • Extend our simulation framework with KPIs, automated scenarios, and evaluation workflows
  • Analyze simulation and field-test data to identify issues and opportunities for improvement
  • Contribute to the core robotics stack in areas such as estimation, perception, planning, control, or mission execution
  • Collaborate closely with robotics, simulation, embedded, and domain experts
  • Gain practical experience developing and validating software for complex autonomous systems


Your profile

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Autonomous Systems, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
  • Good programming skills in C++, ideally modern C++ (17/20)
  • Solid foundation in algorithms, data structures, and software engineering
  • Basic understanding of robotics concepts such as coordinate frames, sensor data, estimation, planning, or control
  • Comfortable working in Linux
  • Curious about complex roboticsystems and motivated to understand how things work beyond your individual component
  • Able to work independently on a defined technical problem while actively seeking feedback when needed
  • Genuine interest in autonomous systems, robotics, and defense technology


Nice to have

You do not need to bring all of these — experience from university projects, research, student teams, personal projects, or previous internships counts. 

  • Experience with ROS or ROS 2
  • Experience with real robots, embedded systems, or hardware-in-the-loop setups
  • Exposure to SLAM, navigation, computer vision, estimation, filtering, planning, or control
  • Interest or experience in multi-agent systems, swarming, or distributed robotics
  • Experience working with LiDAR or camera data
  • Exposure to PX4 or ArduPilot
  • Experience with simulation frameworks such as Gazebo, Isaac Sim, or Unreal Engine
  • Experience with embedded platforms, GPUs, or networking
  • Exposure to machine learning methods


What else

  • Strong problem-solving mindset and willingness to learn
  • Structured and reliable way of working
  • Comfortable working in an environment where not every problem has a predefined solution
  • Collaborative and open to technical feedback
  • High ethical standards and disciplined workethic
  • Extra-curricular engineering projects, robotics competitions, research, or other technical achievements are a plus

The practical part 

  • Duration: 3–6 months, full-time
  • Eligibility: NATO-aligned nationality or close ally citizenship is required

## About the job
We built Bubble with a clear mission: to empower everyone to create software. Our AI visual development platform lets anyone, from first-time entrepreneurs to enterprise teams, take an idea from prompt to fully-functional, scalable app across web, iOS, and Android. With over 6 million users in more than 100 countries, Bubble is breaking down the barriers to entrepreneurship and innovation worldwide.
**Our Product**
Bubble is the only fully visual AI app builder that lets you vibe code without the code to go beyond prototypes and launch real apps to real users. Chat with AI when you want speed, edit directly when you want control. Bubble's visual editor lets you fine-tune any detail, from the design to privacy rules and programming logic, so you're never stuck, even if AI hits its limits. Everything you need comes built in: a unified web and native mobile editor, enterprise-grade hosting, security, database management, and automatic scaling that grows with your business. 
You can [_build just about anything_](https://bubble.io/app-gallery) on Bubble, and our community is living proof. [_Mailead_](https://bubble.io/showcase/mailead) grew a $10K investment into a $2M valuation, and [_Faceless.video_](http://Faceless.video) went from zero to $1M+ ARR in under a year. People aren't just launching products on Bubble, they're building real businesses. See how Bubble builders are shipping apps that change industries, solve problems, and shape the future here: [_Inspiring builders, breakthrough apps_](https://bubble.io/customers).
**Why Join Bubble Now?**
The rise of AI-generated software has validated everything Bubble has been building toward for over a decade. But pure AI-generated code is fragile, hard to debug, and rarely production-ready. Bubble bridges that gap, combining the speed of AI with a structured visual platform that produces stable, scalable, secure software. The people who join Bubble right now will help define what that means for millions of builders around the world. If you've ever wanted to work on something that genuinely changes who gets to build, this is your moment.
**About the team:**
Our Technical Product Support team is an escalation team to our earlier stages of support. We are responsible for providing in-depth, product-level support to our users when they’re facing complex, niche, or app-specific challenges. 
In addition to providing support, we serve as a strategic partner to the rest of the company — escalating platform bugs to our Engineering team, flagging user feedback to our Product team, and supporting new product feature launches alongside our Marketing team, amongst other forms of collaboration. Because we work so closely with our users and product, many on our team grow into specialized focus areas throughout the broader Support/Success org and beyond, including sales, product, marketing, and engineering.
**About the role:**  
  
As part of our growing Technical Product Support team, you’ll spend most of your time interacting directly with our users and ensuring that they achieve success with our software. Because of the nature of the product, the work you’ll do in this role matters: whether you’re helping a hobbyist get the hang of sourcing data or working with a VC-backed startup to scale their app to thousands of users. If you are comfortable in the face of ambiguity, exceptionally analytically minded, and a self-starter with an insatiable appetite for learning, then we want to hear from you. 
**As a Technical Product Support Specialist, you will:**
  * Become an expert in all things Bubble — our product, users, and company
  * Spend the majority of your time providing app-specific support via email, as if you were a member of the user’s team
  * For each issue that you handle, determine if it’s a question about how to build something on Bubble or a bug report about a behavior not working as intended on the platform, then resolve accordingly
  * For bug reports, use our debugging tools to dive into the app and determine if it’s a bug in the user’s code or our code; when it’s a bug in the users code, respond in such a way that empowers the user to self-diagnose their bug in the future; when it’s a platform bug, escalate to Engineering with a concise, clear set of reproduction steps that accelerate the time-to-resolution. In some cases, you may also be empowered to propose AI-assisted code fixes.
